parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. In the **Edge Instances** page of the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance to view its ID.  

You can also invoke the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain it.
